company.title: Architectural Authority Built on Integrity
company.description: Prerana Architects & Associates bridges sophisticated contemporary design aesthetics with rigorous engineering execution. We operate with absolute transparency, eliminating the traditional friction points between complex local bylaws, material sourcing, and site delivery.

metrics.label: Turnkey Autonomy
metrics.subtext: From architectural conceptualization and engineering down to interior fit-outs under a single roof.

metrics.label: Absolute Cost Control
metrics.subtext: A comprehensive Bill of Quantities ensuring fixed pricing structures with zero hidden operational markups.

metrics.label: Real-Time Tracking
metrics.subtext: Complete transparent visibility over daily material logs, site milestones, and engineering schedules.
